---
name: release-notes-hub
description: Summarize verified ecosystem changes into Ventura Studio release notes without overstating maturity or metrics. Use when publishing a coordinated Ventura ecosystem update. Do not use when writing a single repository changelog entry with no hub impact.
---

# Release notes hub

- Gather merged or released changes from the repositories included in the update.
- Separate shipped changes from planned work.
- Link each material change to its repository or release evidence.
- Report metrics only when generated from reproducible evidence.
- Preserve maturity labels used by Ventura Studio.
- Call out breaking changes migrations and security-relevant updates first.
- Keep incubating projects clearly identified as such.
- Validate repository links and dates before publishing.
